reference.question: Given \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle DEF\), \(\angle A=40^\circ\), and \(\angle E=60^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle C\) in degrees.
reference.solution:
Method 1: Corresponding angles and the triangle angle sum

\(\angle B=\angle E=60^\circ\), so \(\angle C=180^\circ-40^\circ-60^\circ=80^\circ\).
